{{Quote|Approximately 12,000 BBY a theocratic conspiracy, centuries in the offing, impeached Chancellor Pers'lya and placed its own man, Contispex, in the seat.|Gabrel Treon, ''Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes''|<ref name="TTSP" />}}
The year '''11,987 before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] (BBY)''' was a span of time that featured significant changes in the leadership of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A cult of conspiratorial religious zealots known as [[Pius Dea]] usurped power over the Republic with the help of a secretive society called the [[Malkite Poisoners]]. The zealots impeached reigning [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Pers'lya]] and installed the Pius Dea figurehead [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]], assassinating the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] not long after he was removed from office. The new chancellor, housing [[Humanocentrism|Humanocentric]] beliefs, then unleashed a series of religious-based [[Pius Dea Crusades|crusades]] against [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and those who worshiped other deities. The rise of the Pius Dea cult marked the end of the [[Kymoodon Era]] and the beginning of the [[Pius Dea Era]].

==Proem==
During the years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], the governing body gradually but steadily expanded its boundaries. Most of the settlements, however, were in a wedge-shaped region of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]. Aside from occasional protrusions into [[Unknown Regions/Legends|unknown areas]] and isolated settlements, most of [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] society lived within the confines of known [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] routes and the established [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. Settlers and explorers, however, continued to search the wild and unexplored areas of the galaxy. In the years leading up to 12,000 BBY, this steady advancement continued.<ref name="NEC" /> The [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] during this time<ref name="TTSP" /> was the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]]<ref name="ValinBlog">{{Blog|valinkenobi|14/comments|TTSP Endnotes: Volume 1}}</ref> [[Pers'lya]]. At the same time, however, the religious conspiracy-based cult of zealots known as [[Pius Dea]] was growing in power. The group held the beliefs of anti-[[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Humanocentrism]] and that followers of other religions were "unbelievers" and idolaters.<ref name="TTSP" />

==The galaxy in 11,987 BBY==
{{Quote|Here we stand, at the extremity of our exertion, having cast behind us the idols of our fathers, to once again carry to our foe the penalties due their sacrileges. Come perdition or hard vacuum, the Republic expects that every citizen will do his duty.|Supreme Chancellor Contispex, ''Fourth Inaugural Oration''|<ref name="TTSP" />}}
During that year, Supreme Chancellor Pres'lya became embroiled in an impeachment scandal. The religious and conspiratorial cult Pius Dea,<ref name="TTSP" /> coupled with the assistance of the secret group known as the [[Malkite Poisoners]],<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> led the ousting of Pers'lya<ref name="TTSP" /> and the installation of Pius Dea figurehead Contispex.<ref name="NEC" /> With Contispex in power, the Pius Dea cult would begin a series of religious-based conflicts known as the [[Pius Dea Crusades]] within several years.<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="TTSP" /> The beginning of the crusades marked the end of the [[Kymoodon Era]] and the beginning of the [[Pius Dea Era]].<ref name="EA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Impact==
{{Quote|These gave as good as they got, and 'cold' and 'hot' wars alternated for a thousand years&mdash;while the Republic flagellated itself with inquisitions&mdash;until Pius Dea rule met its end in that famous encounter which hardly needs retelling here.|Gabrel Treon, ''Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji: A Cartel of Genes''|<ref name="TTSP" />}}
Contispex, as part of Pius Dea, held the belief that alien species and religious-followers were heathen "unbelievers." This view, coupled with the idea that the deities of the non-Human cultures needed to be destroyed, led the chancellor to attack [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. To some, the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] posed a legitimate threat to the Republic. Eventually, however, the Pius Dea crusades turned against other alien species which did not threaten the security of the Republic.<ref name="TTSP" /> Even after the reign of Contispex, Pius Dea controlled the chancellery for about [[11,000 BBY|one thousand more years]], resulting in a devastating series of crusades.<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="TTSP" /> In the end, the crusades caused a rift between the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|rimward]] planets and the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] which would be exploited as late as the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', entries on Contispex and Pius Dea</ref>

==Notable events==
*Supreme Chancellor [[Pers'lya]] is impeached and replaced with [[Contispex I/Legends|Contispex I]], a member of the Pius Dea religious cult.<ref name="NEC" /><ref name="TTSP" />

==Behind the scenes==
The reign of Contispex and Pius Dea is first mentioned in ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''<ref name="NEC" /> with supplemental mentions in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''<ref name="NEGD" /> and ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="CSWE" /> The circumstances surrounding the installation of Contispex and the Pius Dea crusades were expanded upon in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|''Hyperspace'']]-published story ''[[Tinker, Tailor, Soldier, Praji]]'' by [[Nathan O'Keefe]].<ref name="TTSP" /> The Pius Dea era was greatly expanded upon in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', which established definite years for many of the events in the era.<ref name="EGW" />
